name: Laced Finger Blow
body:
A special technique developed by more dexterous behemoths, this ability makes use of both arms on a side striking in near perfect unison.

Prerequisite(s): Behemoth, base attack bonust +5 or monk 5, Improved Unarmed Strike, Dexterity 15

Benefit(s): When making an unarmed strike with at least 2 arms free you may use them in unison for your unarmed strikes, but doing so has you treated as having one less limb. When making unarmed strikes with those particular limbs in this fashion you deal damage as if you were one size larger.
